scope: Remaining freeform token editors, required markers, offer permission copy and contact-change semantics

findings.issue: Brands uses creatable MultiCombobox, max20 entries at80chars. Shared SelectedTokens hides entries after two rows behind +N; pending search query is not draft state.
findings.recommendation: Reuse visible editable list for freeform brand names; normalize on save, keep stated DB limits.

findings.issue: Markets/languages/business tags/certificates remain creatable MultiCombobox. Long freeform certificates/markets can show same large-chip and hidden+N pattern.
findings.recommendation: Apply visible rows to freeform values, particularly certificates; keep category/city predefined selectors.

findings.issue: Distribution save requires region, but region control has no required/asterisk. Channels declares required but shared multi label does not render star.
findings.recommendation: Align required prop/visible star/ARIA and focus validation for regions and channels.

findings.issue: Contact-change outcome shares report_resolved and is labelled complaint. Server Georgian success text in detail.resolution is replaced by generic complaint fallback; detail.kind contact_change already exists to distinguish it.
findings.recommendation: Label contact changes separately and show their actual outcome/login-email distinction; preserve generic unknown-enum fallback for unrelated reports.

findings.issue: Audit report.resolve/report target labels still say complaint including contact-change rejection. contact_change_applied lacks business audit label and becomes generic action.
findings.recommendation: Use inquiry label for general report action/target; add contact change applied action label.

excluded: ProfileItems service/needs fields already assigned to forms agent.
Category and city MultiCombobox uses are valid predefined selectors.
Catalog card +N is a summary leading to full company detail, not a data-entry editor; not flagged as equivalent bug.
Main SendOfferForm/DealTermsForm commercial conditions use direct typed draft values; no remaining token editor there.
No reachable verification-required or companies-only offer-send claim found. Company-only import/setup messages and optional verified filters are correct.
